messages:
Alex Chen: quick design question — on narrow view the compare table filter chips wrap and push the header controls off-screen. i prototyped three options: collapse to a "+N" overflow menu, horizontal scroll for the chips row, or move filters into a left drawer. also worried about screen-reader experience when filters are hidden. any strong opinions? Maya Patel: +1 to +N overflow menu. keeps layout compact and makes state explicit. we just need clear SR text like "Show 3 hidden filters (opens menu)" and a keyboard target. Samir Gupta: horizontal scroll is slick visually but breaks keyboard focus order and is tough for a11y. drawer is heavy-handed for quick toggles. i vote +N overflow, but it must preserve order and be tabbable. Taylor Nguyen: agree +N. small nit: the overflow button should show tooltip on hover and have aria-expanded. also for mobile we should expand the menu full-screen so you can multi-select filters. Alex Chen: good points. what about filtering badges contrast? right now some performance badges use low-contrast gray on white — a11y bot flagged them. Maya Patel: i can update badge colors. aim for 3:1 for decorative badges and 4.5:1 for text labels. maybe use a slightly darker teal for "fast" and darker amber for "cheap". also copy tweak for pinned model indicator: current "Pinned v1.2.3" reads weird. suggest "Pinned • v1.2.3" (dot separator) so it scans better. a11y-bot: quick guidance: for small text (<18px) require a contrast ratio >=4.5:1 per WCAG AA. interactive controls (buttons, menus) need focus styles that are visible at 3:1. Add aria-label to overflow like: `aria-label=\"Show hidden filters (3)\"` and set `aria-expanded` toggled on open. Samir Gupta: example markup i used in a prototype if helpful: ```html

``` Taylor Nguyen: love it. for keyboard: ensure ArrowDown focuses first menuitem and Escape closes. also we should add a small SR-only summary when the overflow is opened like "3 additional filters available" so screen reader users know context. Alex Chen: decision summary: implement +N overflow menu for chip overflow, full-screen multi-select on mobile, ensure tabbable menu with Arrow/Escape behavior, aria-label and SR-announcement on open, bump badge contrast to meet WCAG, and update pinned copy to "Pinned • vX.Y.Z". Alex Chen: action items: @Taylor prototype updated interactions (due EOW), @Maya update microcopy and badge tokens + PR, @Samir add QA checklist for keyboard + screen reader flows. i'll handle rollout notes and add a quick Cypress keyboard test. Maya Patel: noted. will include color swatches and contrast ratios in PR. Samir Gupta: will test with NVDA + VoiceOver. Taylor Nguyen: i'll drop a loom of the prototype when done. :thumbsup:
